Resolves #21332

`captureExamples.mjs` gains a tile mode. `example-captures.json` lists workbench entries by their `examples/` path, and `--tiles` (or `--tile <path>`) crops each entry's stage component into a padded 4:3 region. Before the crop, the whole workbench switches to the first dark theme the page offers (`neo-theme-neo-dark`, else `neo-theme-dark`), clicking the switch only while that theme is inactive. The crop covers what the stage shows of the component: leaves, media, text and decorated boxes, clipped to the stage, but not a decorated wrapper as large as the stage. Padding gives way before content does; a component no tile-aspect region inside the stage can hold fails the run instead of being cut. 36 entries are listed: the Forms & Fields entries, the form layout, and the button, menu, list, component and functional entries that need no renewal first. The other entries join the list with their renewals. The bytes are in neomjs/pages#109, which merges first.

Evidence: L3 (two full runs of the final producer against the dev server; unit spec) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-4). Residual: none.

Time-derived: `form-field-date` and `component-dateSelector` render the capture day, because the App worker keeps the real clock (a Playwright clock pinned the main thread to `2026-01-15` while the field still showed `2026-11-18`). Every other entry renders fixed values. |

| AC-4 | Outside-CI: the 36 tiles at 180 px, six per row as at 1440 × 900 beside the list, in static markup (frame below). |

## Deltas from ticket

- The dark theme falls back to `neo-theme-dark`, because the field and component entries configure no `neo-theme-neo-dark`.
- A crop takes the component's natural size at 4:3 (at least 160 × 120 CSS px) rather than zooming the component. The Portal scales the bitmap into the tile, so the page's DOM stays untouched.
- The chip field's tile stays out of neomjs/pages#109 until #21352 merges: on `dev` its chips render unstyled (#21349).

## Test Evidence

![The first 36 tiles at 180 px](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/21f4334c9ed517e4eb3eaf029c29f92760e02e4d/review-evidence/21332/tiles-at-180px.png?raw=true)

The weak tiles show what their entries show today: a bare field labelled "Label", a long thin combobox, the seven stacked upload fields. The states template (#21334) and the renewals replace those stages, and a rerun of their paths refreshes the tiles. The board predates this head in two tiles: magicmovetext is now cropped to its component, and the chip field (shown with the label overlap #21327 fixed) is held back.
